_comment: Same person under two Leaguepedia links (a redirect or an alternate spelling the build did not resolve): duplicate id → id kept. Applied by scripts/build-player-db.js on every build and once to the existing data by scripts/merge-duplicate-players.js. The old ids stay readable in saved games (players-index.json alias entries). Players who only share a nick (Faker / Faker (Noh Woo-seok)) are different people: never list them here.
